integrity: The proof combines an exact active-facet classification of every unit isosceles pair with analytic one-variable lower bounds. The bundled checker certifies the finite polyhedral decomposition and exact polynomial identities. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the exponent \(p=2\) and the affine-regular hexagonal plane; it neither gives the full \(H_p\) profile nor classifies all extremizers.
title: Exact \(H_2\) constant of the affine-regular hexagonal Banach plane
